# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [BioBasicsBench tests when laboratory evidence cannot support an answer](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-07/01-biobasicsbench-lab-evidence.html) — OpenAI introduced 100 tasks, while analysis scores remain distinct from readiness for independent laboratory work.
- [OpenAI and Hacktron will test connections between services](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-07/02-hacktron-service-boundaries.html) — The partnership broadens research into system interactions without certifying that vulnerabilities are absent.
- [Cognitive Tours proposes preserving the reasons behind code changes](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-07/03-cognitive-tours-understanding.html) — A preprint describes navigation through decisions and evidence, with team benefits still to be evaluated.
- [NASA publishes its Supercomputing 2026 demonstration programme](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-07/04-nasa-supercomputing-programme.html) — The November 17–19 programme covers Fortran, offload, hydrology and infrastructure; the presentations are still ahead.
- [Harness adapters target the environment an agent actually uses](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-07/05-harness-adapters-evaluation.html) — The authors describe LoRA and tool-call screening, while early results do not establish reliability across arbitrary tasks.
- [Today’s APOD shows the lunar south pole from a favourable angle](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-07/06-lunar-massif-perspective.html) — The October 31 image highlights De Gerlache-Kocher without announcing a landing-site selection.
- [Cosmos 3 separates scene generation from validating a physical world](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/01-cosmos-interactive-worlds.html) — NVIDIA described models for interactive simulation, while convincing video alone does not establish suitability for policy learning.
- [Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash extends clips and adds conversational editing](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/02-omni-longer-video.html) — Google announced 15-second generation, while duration and pricing changes do not substitute for checking the finished video.
- [Australian universities connect AI access with assessment rules](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/03-university-ai-assessment.html) — A new OpenAI account describes staged rollouts, while tool access and evidence of learning remain different outcomes.
- [NASA presents X-70 as a reconfigurable flight-research platform](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/04-x70-research-platform.html) — The crewed Fractal is intended for experiments, with its first flight under NASA expected within two years.
- [NASA selects three companies to develop Ka-band relay concepts](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/05-ka-band-relay-concepts.html) — Contracts begin with concepts and risk reduction, with maximum values including future options rather than current work alone.
- [ToyBlocks turns tabletop blocks into a robotics testbed](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/06-toyblocks-controlled-robotics.html) — Ai2 introduced a controlled environment designed to help separate planning failures from execution failures.
- [Open ASR Leaderboard adds Egyptian and Nigerian English](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/07-asr-accent-evaluation.html) — New private test splits broaden accent coverage without representing every kind of speech.
- [LeRobot 0.7 adds interaction with a running robot policy](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/08-lerobot-interactive-release.html) — The November 5 release brings interactive sessions, streamed training data and remote inference.
- [ISS completes installation of eight roll-out solar arrays](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/09-iss-final-solar-array.html) — NASA confirmed deployment of the final IROSA on November 5, advancing beyond the October delivery milestone.
- [An orbital view reveals the San Juan River’s entrenched bends](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-06/10-goosenecks-orbital-view.html) — NASA published the October 6 photograph on November 6; its geological explanation does not turn it into a newly occurring event.
- [Phonon demonstrates local speech with different licenses across variants](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-05/01-phonon-local-speech.html) — Gradium's new account discusses previously released models, with quality, speed and usage terms requiring separate assessment.
- [Dharma separates page transcription from extracting requested fields](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-05/02-dharma-document-fields.html) — Field Extractor offers schema-directed JSON, whose evaluation must distinguish correct structure from correct values.
- [Landsat shows the land bridges that reshaped southern Cyprus](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-05/03-cyprus-land-bridges.html) — A new NASA account connects an October view of Akrotiri with ancient ocean crust, river sediment and a seasonal lake.
- [A new M30 portrait shows how observations accumulate history](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-05/04-m30-galactic-history.html) — Hubble combines several observing programs, while unusual cluster motion remains a clue rather than definitive proof of origin.
